_comment: The indexing engine release Shimmr bundles.
These must point at the ENGINE PROJECT'S OWN published release artifacts,
not at a binary we built ourselves. A build we produce has a different
build fingerprint, and the engine refuses to run two differing builds for
one OS account (ADR 0007) — so a self-built bundle would fail to start for
any customer who already runs the engine directly.
Bumping the engine is therefore a deliberate act: update version, update
every sha256, and note the change in docs/internal/ATTRIBUTION.md.
Empty values are intentional and make the release job fail loudly rather
